before.description: Triggered by completing the safehouse setup.

actions.message:
Quest Complete: Under the Radar

With Zeke grounding the terminal and checking the room's wiring, Orion folds a quiet Source shield around the borrowed apartment. Outside, the Spire keeps listening to itself. Inside, the crew has a room the city cannot own. Zeke names the next problem: the Upper City can only be reached through workers, schedules, badges, and people the rich refuse to see.

after.description: Triggered by completing the safehouse setup.

before.description: Triggered when talking to Jax.

actions.message: Jax slides a data drive across the counter. 'Curfew schedules, elevator shift gossip, and a list of guards who owe me. Don't make me regret remembering Zeke before the city deleted him.'

after.description: Triggered when talking to Jax.

actions.message: Jax slides a data drive across the counter. 'Curfew schedules, elevator shifts, and guards who owe me. You said you came from the mines. Then you know what Dominion does to people it thinks nobody will miss. Get your crew through, and keep my name out of their reports.'

before.description: Copy service badge patterns at the elevator service gate.

actions.message: Gh0st ghosts the freight badge handshake long enough to copy a service pattern. The climb has a door now, but only if everyone looks like they belong beneath it.

after.description: Copy service badge patterns at the elevator service gate.

actions.message: Gh0st intercepts the freight badge reader's authentication signal and copies a valid service pattern. The badges will get you through the gate, provided your uniforms match the clearance.

before.description: Triggered when installing neon core.

actions.message:
Quest Complete: Neon Fix

The sign flickers and flares back to life, bathing the subway car in neon purple. The bar looks watched, open, and ordinary again, which is the safest kind of lie. Jax grunts in approval and slides the reward across the counter.

after.description: Triggered when installing neon core.

before.description: Begin the Upper City heist after the Lower City plan is complete.

actions.message:
Quest Complete: The Plan

Zeke combines the schedules, badges, disguises and security records into a service route. He sends the Astra’s autopilot a maintenance clearance to relocate from the sewer dock to the rooftop pad. The crew rides the service lift into Upper City.

after.description: Begin the Upper City heist after the Lower City plan is complete.

before.description: Zeke and Orion disable sensors from Laundry Service.

actions.message: Zeke ghosts the scanner grid from the Laundry Service sensor console while Orion dampens the Source noise. The penthouse sensors blink blind for one narrow window, and the crew moves before fear can vote.

after.description: Zeke and Orion disable sensors from Laundry Service.

before.description: Nova and Gh0st pass the lobby scanners.

actions.message:
Quest Complete: Social Engineering

The service chute spits Nova and Gh0st past the scanners while Zeke and Orion keep the grid blind. The crew has fooled the Upper City by becoming the people it refuses to see. The Archive opens ahead, and every second now has teeth.

after.description: Nova and Gh0st pass the lobby scanners.

before.description: Take the Lens and trigger the alarm.

actions.message:
Quest Complete: The Lens

The relic burns cold in Nova's hand. The Shield above the Spire becomes visible as rotating chords, and so does the thin old thread running through her own signal. Alarm text blooms across the air: ANOMALY DETECTED. The only route left is through the drone alcove and up to the roof, where the Astra has one impossible launch window.

The Astra clears the Spire’s internal security curtain on Orion’s count. The planetary Shield still hangs above them. Zeke sets a low-altitude course for the Foundry: its Deep-Core Engine can carry them higher, and its Phase-Cutter Arrays can open the way.

before.speaker: Jax
before.text: Patrols are sweeping the streets. There's an abandoned apartment upstairs; you can use it while you get your bearings. I'll leave the stairwell open. Keep trouble away from my customers.

after.speaker: Jax
after.text: Easy. You're dripping sewer water on my floor, and you've checked the door three times. I'm Jax. This is The Static; people come here to get out of the patrols' way. What happened?

before.speaker: Jax
before.text: You want the Upper City? You need timing, credentials, a route, disguises, and the nerve to look bored while they judge your humanity.

options.text: Yes, Zeke said you have the schedules.

after.speaker: Jax
after.text: You want the Upper City? You need timing, credentials, a route, disguises, and the nerve to look bored while they judge your humanity.

options.text: We need a way past the patrols. Can you help?

before.speaker: System
before.text: Zeke's workstation accepts the stolen timing, badges, and disguise notes. His restored employee profile compiles into a service-elevator route.

after.speaker: System
after.text: Zeke's workstation combines the stolen schedules, copied service badges, and disguise notes into a freight-elevator clearance. The Dominion menus work just like the mine checkpoint; the identities on these badges belong to this building's service crew.

before.speaker: System
before.text: The planning table maps the infiltration route: patrol timing, badges, and disguises align into a clear path upward.

options.text: Coordinate heist plan.

after.speaker: System
after.text: The route is ready: return to Transit Plaza in the copied uniforms, use the freight badges at the service elevator, and ride up to the Upper City laundry intake. Zeke will send the Astra's autopilot clearance to move to the rooftop pad while the crew travels on foot. Once you leave this table, the heist begins.

options.text: Commit the plan and take the service elevator upstairs.
Keep preparing. Leave the table for now.

before.speaker: Zeke
before.text: Sir, this commemorative installation is delicate. Touch it again and I will have to file paperwork neither of us wants to read.

after.speaker: Zeke
after.text: Maintenance crew, sir. If you want to report us, the staff checkpoint can verify our clearance. Of course, they'll need to know why you stopped a scheduled service round.

options.text: What is Bridgman Civil working on up here?
Do you help with the sound for The Static?
You seem to know everyone on this deck.
Who's that in the photo on your tool locker?
Need an extra pair of hands on the rigging?
I brought the heavy gears and wiring bundles for the center truss.
